summary.text: Robert C. White Jr. is an At-Large member of the Council of the District of Columbia, in his third term, and chairs the Council's Committee on Housing.

paragraphs.text: He was first elected to the Council in 2016.

Earlier, he worked in the U.S. House of Representatives as Legislative Counsel to Eleanor Holmes Norton, and in 2014 became the first Director of Community Outreach for the DC Office of the Attorney General.
He is an adjunct professor at Georgetown University Law Center and lives in Ward 4 with his family.
